It combines the accessibility of Canva with the power of Adobe, giving storytellers complete authorship over the final result. The company created 50+ films in its first seven months, then turned what it learned into software that lets marketing and GTM leaders create complete videos for their storytelling needs. Leaders at Webflow, Resend, Rho, and Gumloop already rely on Osmo to produce videos with more creative control.
